scope: Document conversion and media import validation, with fixture preparation for the native UI test controlled by the parent agent

coverage: Image decode success, failure, invalid dimensions, and timeout
Video frame decode success, failure, and decoder cleanup
Mixed valid and invalid file imports preserve the valid files
Corrupted PDF load always destroys the PDF.js task

fixes: Reject modern Office and OpenDocument files without a ZIP package header so LibreOffice cannot silently import corrupted bytes as text.
Decode imported images and videos before adding presentation slides, reject damaged or unsupported media, and remove failed cache copies.
Grant file removal only within the application's media directory so deleting imported documents can remove their cached page images.
Destroy the PDF.js loading task after both failed and successful loads.

rustChecks.strictClippy: passed for fellowshow --lib --tests before a separate concurrent STT edit
rustChecks.optionalLatestConversionRerun: An additional rerun after removing the fixture's default Word title border was blocked by a concurrent whisper.rs type-inference error. The completed 7-check native conversion run had already passed.

limitations: This agent did not operate the native UI. The parent agent must verify the actual app's file picker, page navigation, preview-to-live flow, and file cleanup.
The file-header check validates the ZIP container signature, not every part of an Office package. LibreOffice still performs the full conversion.
The media check validates an image or the first decoded video frame. It cannot prove every later video frame is intact.
No installed Office application, credential, external display, or microphone was used.
